{"command":"cat > make_docs.py <<'PY'
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT, WD_CELL_VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_SECTION
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.enum.style import WD_STYLE_TYPE
from docx.enum.text import WD_LINE_SPACING
from docx.enum.table import WD_ROW_HEIGHT_RULE
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from pathlib import Path

OUT=Path('output')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
RED=RGBColor(0xC0,0x00,0x00)
BLUE=RGBColor(0x00,0x44,0x88)
GRAY=RGBColor(0x66,0x66,0x66)
DARK=RGBColor(0x22,0x22,0x22)
GREEN=RGBColor(0x00,0x66,0x33)


def set_cell_shading(cell, fill):
    tcPr=cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); shd=tcPr.find(qn('w:shd'))
    if shd is None: shd=OxmlElement('w:shd'); tcPr.append(shd)
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), fill)

def set_cell_border(cell, **kwargs):
    tc = cell._tc; tcPr = tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); tcBorders=tcPr.first_child_found_in('w:tcBorders')
    if tcBorders is None: tcBorders=OxmlElement('w:tcBorders'); tcPr.append(tcBorders)
    for edge in ('top','left','bottom','right','insideH','insideV'):
        if edge in kwargs:
            tag='w:{}'.format(edge); element=tcBorders.find(qn(tag))
            if element is None: element=OxmlElement(tag); tcBorders.append(element)
            for k,v in kwargs[edge].items(): element.set(qn('w:'+k), str(v))

def set_repeat_table_header(row):
    trPr=row._tr.get_or_add_trPr(); tblHeader=OxmlElement('w:tblHeader'); tblHeader.set(qn('w:val'),'true'); trPr.append(tblHeader)

def add_page_number(paragraph):
    run=paragraph.add_run(); fldChar1=OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar1.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'begin')
    instrText=OxmlElement('w:instrText'); instrText.set(qn('xml:space'),'preserve'); instrText.text='PAGE'
    fldChar2=OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar2.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'end')
    run._r.append(fldChar1); run._r.append(instrText); run._r.append(fldChar2)

def setup(doc, title):
    sec=doc.sections[0]; sec.top_margin=Inches(.65); sec.bottom_margin=Inches(.65); sec.left_margin=Inches(.7); sec.right_margin=Inches(.7)
    styles=doc.styles
    styles['Normal'].font.name='Arial'; styles['Normal'].font.size=Pt(9)
    styles['Normal'].paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(4)
    for name,size,color in [('Title',18,BLUE),('Heading 1',14,BLUE),('Heading 2',11,BLUE),('Heading 3',9.5,DARK)]:
        st=styles[name]; st.font.name='Arial'; st.font.size=Pt(size); st.font.bold=True; st.font.color.rgb=color
    # custom
    if 'Redline Addition' not in styles:
        st=styles.add_style('Redline Addition', WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH); st.base_style=styles['Normal']; st.font.name='Arial'; st.font.size=Pt(9); st.font.color.rgb=RED
    if 'Comment Text' not in styles:
        st=styles.add_style('Comment Text', WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH); st.base_style=styles['Normal']; st.font.name='Arial'; st.font.size=Pt(8); st.font.color.rgb=DARK
    # footer
    foot=sec.footer.paragraphs[0]; foot.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    r=foot.add_run('PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT | '); r.font.size=Pt(8); r.font.color.rgb=GRAY
    add_page_number(foot)
    return doc

def title(doc, text, subtitle=None):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(); p.style='Title'; p.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER; p.add_run(text)
    if subtitle:
        p=doc.add_paragraph(); p.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER; r=p.add_run(subtitle); r.bold=True; r.font.size=Pt(10); r.font.color.rgb=GRAY

def smallcaps(p, text, color=BLUE):
    r=p.add_run(text); r.bold=True; r.font.color.rgb=color; r.font.size=Pt(8.5); return r

def add_meta(doc, rows):
    t=doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=2); t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER; t.autofit=True
    for k,v in rows:
        cells=t.add_row().cells; cells[0].text=k; cells[1].text=v
        set_cell_shading(cells[0],'D9EAF7');
        for p in cells[0].paragraphs: p.runs[0].bold=True
        for c in cells: set_cell_border(c,top={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'},bottom={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'},left={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'},right={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'})
    doc.add_paragraph()

def para(doc, text='', bold=False, italic=False, color=None, style=None, align=None):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    if align is not None: p.alignment=align
    r=p.add_run(text); r.bold=bold; r.italic=italic
    if color: r.font.color.rgb=color
    return p

def bullet(doc, text, level=0):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(style='List Bullet' if level==0 else 'List Bullet 2'); p.add_run(text); return p

def add_clause(doc, heading, old=None, new=None, comment=None, priority='SIGNIFICANT', comment_id=None):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(); p.style='Heading 2'; p.add_run(heading)
    if old is not None:
        p=doc.add_paragraph(); r=p.add_run('DELETED — ' + old); r.font.color.rgb=RED; r.font.strike=True
    if new is not None:
        p=doc.add_paragraph(); r=p.add_run('ADDED / REVISED — ' + new); r.font.color.rgb=RED; r.font.underline=True
    if comment:
        add_comment(doc, comment_id, priority, comment[0], comment[1], comment[2])

def add_comment(doc, cid, priority, basis, risk, position):
    t=doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1); t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER; cell=t.cell(0,0); set_cell_shading(cell, 'FFF2CC' if priority=='CRITICAL' else ('EAF2F8' if priority=='SIGNIFICANT' else 'F2F2F2'))
    set_cell_border(cell,top={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'},bottom={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'},left={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'},right={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'})
    p=cell.paragraphs[0]; r=p.add_run(f'COMMENT {cid} — {priority}'); r.bold=True; r.font.color.rgb=RED if priority=='CRITICAL' else BLUE
    for label,txt in [('Basis',basis),('Risk to Polaris',risk),('Position / flexibility',position)]:
        p=cell.add_paragraph(style='Comment Text'); rr=p.add_run(label+': '); rr.bold=True; p.add_run(txt)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(1)

def add_table(doc, headers, rows, widths=None, font=8):
    t=doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers)); t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER; t.style='Table Grid'
    hdr=t.rows[0]; set_repeat_table_header(hdr)
    for i,h in enumerate(headers):
        hdr.cells[i].text=h; set_cell_shading(hdr.cells[i],'1F4E79')
        for p in hdr.cells[i].paragraphs:
            for r in p.runs: r.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(255,255,255); r.bold=True; r.font.size=Pt(font)
    for row in rows:
        cells=t.add_row().cells
        for i,val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text=str(val)
            for p in cells[i].paragraphs:
                for r in p.runs: r.font.size=Pt(font)
            if len(t.rows)%2==0: set_cell_shading(cells[i],'F7FAFC')
    return t

**Planning document styling**

I need to think about extracting the original document's styling or maybe creating our own. I want to draft content programmatically and consider using redline markup instead of actual tracked revisions. I could show deleted clauses with red strikethroughs labeled "DELETED" and new ones with red underlines labeled "ADDED." That feels more direct. I’m also pondering whether to use comments in the document, but maybe it’s better not to. I'll outline the redline sections, including the title, executive summary, conventions, and definition changes.

**Reviewing article amendments**

I’m considering leaving the definition and amending section 7.1. For Article 2, I’m thinking of adding legal/third-party disclaimers and possibly reserving equitable relief in §2.3. In Article 3, I plan to fully replace §3.1, keep §3.2 as is, and add conditions for Buyer cooperation in §3.3. Article 4 will have §4.3 replaced and limit reporting in §4.4. There are many other amendments across Articles 5 to 9 that I’m organizing based on specific requirements.

**Revising articles 10 and 11**

For Article 10, I plan to replace §10.1 entirely with a cap for the first 12 months, making it rolling and noting any exceptions. §10.2 will undergo mutual replacement as well. Moving to Article 11, I'm considering whether to delete the provider representations in subsections (a) to (c) or narrow them down, as the current draft feels too broad. I need to ensure the representations are necessary and sufficient, with limitations on warranty beyond historical service standards.

**Creating a document with bash**

I need to generate a docx file using bash and ensure that the task configuration doesn’t get read incorrectly. It's important that I craft this carefully. I plan to stylize the document, adding comments in tables with shading. I should use redline text for emphasis, incorporating red color along with strikethrough and underline features. Additionally, I'll include a summary table for the redline sections. Alright, let's get coding on this!

from docx import Document

BLUE=RGBColor(0x00,0x44,0x88)
GRAY=RGBColor(0x66,0x66,0x66)
DARK=RGBColor(0x22,0x22,0x22)
GREEN=RGBColor(0x00,0x66,0x33)


def set_cell_shading(cell, fill):
    tcPr=cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); shd=tcPr.find(qn('w:shd'))
    if shd is None: shd=OxmlElement('w:shd'); tcPr.append(shd)
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), fill)

def set_cell_border(cell, **kwargs):
    tc = cell._tc; tcPr = tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); tcBorders=tcPr.first_child_found_in('w:tcBorders')
    if tcBorders is None: tcBorders=OxmlElement('w:tcBorders'); tcPr.append(tcBorders)
    for edge in ('top','left','bottom','right','insideH','insideV'):
        if edge in kwargs:
            tag='w:{}'.format(edge); element=tcBorders.find(qn(tag))
            if element is None: element=OxmlElement(tag); tcBorders.append(element)
            for k,v in kwargs[edge].items(): element.set(qn('w:'+k), str(v))

def set_repeat_table_header(row):
    trPr=row._tr.get_or_add_trPr(); tblHeader=OxmlElement('w:tblHeader'); tblHeader.set(qn('w:val'),'true'); trPr.append(tblHeader)

def add_page_number(paragraph):
    run=paragraph.add_run(); fldChar1=OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar1.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'begin')
    instrText=OxmlElement('w:instrText'); instrText.set(qn('xml:space'),'preserve'); instrText.text='PAGE'
    fldChar2=OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar2.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'end')

def setup(doc, title):
    sec=doc.sections[0]; sec.top_margin=Inches(.65); sec.bottom_margin=Inches(.65); sec.left_margin=Inches(.7); sec.right_margin=Inches(.7)
    styles=doc.styles
    styles['Normal'].font.name='Arial'; styles['Normal'].font.size=Pt(9)
    styles['Normal'].paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(4)
    for name,size,color in [('Title',18,BLUE),('Heading 1',14,BLUE),('Heading 2',11,BLUE),('Heading 3',9.5,DARK)]:
        st=styles[name]; st.font.name='Arial'; st.font.size=Pt(size); st.font.bold=True; st.font.color.rgb=color
    # custom
    if 'Redline Addition' not in styles:
        st=styles.add_style('Redline Addition', WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH); st.base_style=styles['Normal']; st.font.name='Arial'; st.font.size=Pt(9); st.font.color.rgb=RED
    if 'Comment Text' not in styles:
        st=styles.add_style('Comment Text', WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH); st.base_style=styles['Normal']; st.font.name='Arial'; st.font.size=Pt(8); st.font.color.rgb=DARK
    # footer
    foot=sec.footer.paragraphs[0]; foot.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    r=foot.add_run('PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT | '); r.font.size=Pt(8); r.font.color.rgb=GRAY
    add_page_number(foot)
    return doc

def title(doc, text, subtitle=None):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(); p.style='Title'; p.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER; p.add_run(text)
    if subtitle:
        p=doc.add_paragraph(); p.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER; r=p.add_run(subtitle); r.bold=True; r.font.size=Pt(10); r.font.color.rgb=GRAY

def smallcaps(p, text, color=BLUE):
    r=p.add_run(text); r.bold=True; r.font.color.rgb=color; r.font.size=Pt(8.5); return r

def add_meta(doc, rows):
    t=doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=2); t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER; t.autofit=True
    for k,v in rows:
        cells=t.add_row().cells; cells[0].text=k; cells[1].text=v
        set_cell_shading(cells[0],'D9EAF7');
        for p in cells[0].paragraphs: p.runs[0].bold=True
        for c in cells: set_cell_border(c,top={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'},bottom={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'},left={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'},right={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'})
    doc.add_paragraph()

def para(doc, text='', bold=False, italic=False, color=None, style=None, align=None):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    if align is not None: p.alignment=align
    r=p.add_run(text); r.bold=bold; r.italic=italic
    if color: r.font.color.rgb=color
    return p

def bullet(doc, text, level=0):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(style='List Bullet' if level==0 else 'List Bullet 2'); p.add_run(text); return p

def add_clause(doc, heading, old=None, new=None, comment=None, priority='SIGNIFICANT', comment_id=None):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(); p.style='Heading 2'; p.add_run(heading)
    if old is not None:
        p=doc.add_paragraph(); r=p.add_run('DELETED — ' + old); r.font.color.rgb=RED; r.font.strike=True
    if new is not None:
        p=doc.add_paragraph(); r=p.add_run('ADDED / REVISED — ' + new); r.font.color.rgb=RED; r.font.underline=True
    if comment:
        add_comment(doc, comment_id, priority, comment[0], comment[1], comment[2])

def add_comment(doc, cid, priority, basis, risk, position):
    t=doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1); t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER; cell=t.cell(0,0); set_cell_shading(cell, 'FFF2CC' if priority=='CRITICAL' else ('EAF2F8' if priority=='SIGNIFICANT' else 'F2F2F2'))
    set_cell_border(cell,top={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'},bottom={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'},left={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'},right={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'})
    p=cell.paragraphs[0]; r=p.add_run(f'COMMENT {cid} — {priority}'); r.bold=True; r.font.color.rgb=RED if priority=='CRITICAL' else BLUE
    for label,txt in [('Basis',basis),('Risk to Polaris',risk),('Position / flexibility',position)]:
        p=cell.add_paragraph(style='Comment Text'); rr=p.add_run(label+': '); rr.bold=True; p.add_run(txt)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(1)

def add_table(doc, headers, rows, widths=None, font=8):
    t=doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers)); t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER; t.style='Table Grid'
    hdr=t.rows[0]; set_repeat_table_header(hdr)
    for i,h in enumerate(headers):
        hdr.cells[i].text=h; set_cell_shading(hdr.cells[i],'1F4E79')
        for p in hdr.cells[i].paragraphs:
            for r in p.runs: r.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(255,255,255); r.bold=True; r.font.size=Pt(font)
    for row in rows:
        cells=t.add_row().cells
        for i,val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text=str(val)
            for p in cells[i].paragraphs:
                for r in p.runs: r.font.size=Pt(font)
            if len(t.rows)%2==0: set_cell_shading(cells[i],'F7FAFC')
    return t

from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT, WD_CELL_VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_SECTION
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.enum.style import WD_STYLE_TYPE
from docx.enum.text import WD_LINE_SPACING
from docx.enum.table import WD_ROW_HEIGHT_RULE
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from pathlib import Path

OUT=Path('output')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
RED=RGBColor(0xC0,0x00,0x00)
BLUE=RGBColor(0x00,0x44,0x88)
GRAY=RGBColor(0x66,0x66,0x66)
DARK=RGBColor(0x22,0x22,0x22)
GREEN=RGBColor(0x00,0x66,0x33)


def set_cell_shading(cell, fill):
    tcPr=cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); shd=tcPr.find(qn('w:shd'))
    if shd is None: shd=OxmlElement('w:shd'); tcPr.append(shd)
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), fill)

def set_cell_border(cell, **kwargs):
    tc = cell._tc; tcPr = tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); tcBorders=tcPr.first_child_found_in('w:tcBorders')
    if tcBorders is None: tcBorders=OxmlElement('w:tcBorders'); tcPr.append(tcBorders)
    for edge in ('top','left','bottom','right','insideH','insideV'):
        if edge in kwargs:
            tag='w:{}'.format(edge); element=tcBorders.find(qn(tag))
            if element is None: element=OxmlElement(tag); tcBorders.append(element)
            for k,v in kwargs[edge].items(): element.set(qn('w:'+k), str(v))

def set_repeat_table_header(row):
    trPr=row._tr.get_or_add_trPr(); tblHeader=OxmlElement('w:tblHeader'); tblHeader.set(qn('w:val'),'true'); trPr.append(tblHeader)

def add_page_number(paragraph):
    run=paragraph.add_run(); fldChar1=OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar1.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'begin')
    instrText=OxmlElement('w:instrText'); instrText.set(qn('xml:space'),'preserve'); instrText.text='PAGE'
    fldChar2=OxmlElement('w:fldChar'); fldChar2.set(qn('w:fldCharType'),'end')
    run._r.append(fldChar1); run._r.append(instrText); run._r.append(fldChar2)

def setup(doc, title):
    sec=doc.sections[0]; sec.top_margin=Inches(.65); sec.bottom_margin=Inches(.65); sec.left_margin=Inches(.7); sec.right_margin=Inches(.7)
    styles=doc.styles
    styles['Normal'].font.name='Arial'; styles['Normal'].font.size=Pt(9)
    styles['Normal'].paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(4)
    for name,size,color in [('Title',18,BLUE),('Heading 1',14,BLUE),('Heading 2',11,BLUE),('Heading 3',9.5,DARK)]:
        st=styles[name]; st.font.name='Arial'; st.font.size=Pt(size); st.font.bold=True; st.font.color.rgb=color
    # custom
    if 'Redline Addition' not in styles:
        st=styles.add_style('Redline Addition', WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH); st.base_style=styles['Normal']; st.font.name='Arial'; st.font.size=Pt(9); st.font.color.rgb=RED
    if 'Comment Text' not in styles:
        st=styles.add_style('Comment Text', WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH); st.base_style=styles['Normal']; st.font.name='Arial'; st.font.size=Pt(8); st.font.color.rgb=DARK
    # footer
    foot=sec.footer.paragraphs[0]; foot.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    r=foot.add_run('PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT | '); r.font.size=Pt(8); r.font.color.rgb=GRAY
    add_page_number(foot)
    return doc

def title(doc, text, subtitle=None):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(); p.style='Title'; p.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER; p.add_run(text)
    if subtitle:
        p=doc.add_paragraph(); p.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER; r=p.add_run(subtitle); r.bold=True; r.font.size=Pt(10); r.font.color.rgb=GRAY

def smallcaps(p, text, color=BLUE):
    r=p.add_run(text); r.bold=True; r.font.color.rgb=color; r.font.size=Pt(8.5); return r

def add_meta(doc, rows):
    t=doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=2); t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER; t.autofit=True
    for k,v in rows:
        cells=t.add_row().cells; cells[0].text=k; cells[1].text=v
        set_cell_shading(cells[0],'D9EAF7');
        for p in cells[0].paragraphs: p.runs[0].bold=True
        for c in cells: set_cell_border(c,top={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'},bottom={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'},left={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'},right={'val':'single','sz':'4','color':'B7C9D6'})
    doc.add_paragraph()

def para(doc, text='', bold=False, italic=False, color=None, style=None, align=None):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    if align is not None: p.alignment=align
    r=p.add_run(text); r.bold=bold; r.italic=italic
    if color: r.font.color.rgb=color
    return p

def bullet(doc, text, level=0):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(style='List Bullet' if level==0 else 'List Bullet 2'); p.add_run(text); return p

def add_clause(doc, heading, old=None, new=None, comment=None, priority='SIGNIFICANT', comment_id=None):
    p=doc.add_paragraph(); p.style='Heading 2'; p.add_run(heading)
    if old is not None:
        p=doc.add_paragraph(); r=p.add_run('DELETED — ' + old); r.font.color.rgb=RED; r.font.strike=True
    if new is not None:
        p=doc.add_paragraph(); r=p.add_run('ADDED / REVISED — ' + new); r.font.color.rgb=RED; r.font.underline=True
    if comment:
        add_comment(doc, comment_id, priority, comment[0], comment[1], comment[2])

def add_comment(doc, cid, priority, basis, risk, position):
    t=doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1); t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER; cell=t.cell(0,0); set_cell_shading(cell, 'FFF2CC' if priority=='CRITICAL' else ('EAF2F8' if priority=='SIGNIFICANT' else 'F2F2F2'))
    set_cell_border(cell,top={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'},bottom={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'},left={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'},right={'val':'single','sz':'8','color':'C9A227'})
    p=cell.paragraphs[0]; r=p.add_run(f'COMMENT {cid} — {priority}'); r.bold=True; r.font.color.rgb=RED if priority=='CRITICAL' else BLUE
    for label,txt in [('Basis',basis),('Risk to Polaris',risk),('Position / flexibility',position)]:
        p=cell.add_paragraph(style='Comment Text'); rr=p.add_run(label+': '); rr.bold=True; p.add_run(txt)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(1)

def add_table(doc, headers, rows, widths=None, font=8):
    t=doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers)); t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER; t.style='Table Grid'
    hdr=t.rows[0]; set_repeat_table_header(hdr)
    for i,h in enumerate(headers):
        hdr.cells[i].text=h; set_cell_shading(hdr.cells[i],'1F4E79')
        for p in hdr.cells[i].paragraphs:
            for r in p.runs: r.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(255,255,255); r.bold=True; r.font.size=Pt(font)
    for row in rows:
        cells=t.add_row().cells
        for i,val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text=str(val)
            for p in cells[i].paragraphs:
                for r in p.runs: r.font.size=Pt(font)
            if len(t.rows)%2==0: set_cell_shading(cells[i],'F7FAFC')
    return t

--- output/tsa-markup-redline.docx
**Transition Services Agreement --- Polaris / Trident Specialty Coatings Divestiture**

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Draft reviewed**                  Trident draft TSA dated April 28, 2025
  ----------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Governing benchmark**             APA dated March 14, 2025, §7.12 and Exhibit H; Polaris TSA Playbook v4.2 (Jan. 15, 2025)

  **Closing assumption**              June 2, 2025

  **Markup posture**                  Polaris as Service Provider; redline reflects firm APA compliance positions and playbook opening positions
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**IMPORTANT REVIEW NOTE**

This document is a seller-side markup aid. Deletions are shown in red strikethrough; additions/revisions are shown in red underline. Yellow/blue callout boxes are annotated comments, not operative contract text. Unchanged draft language is treated as retained unless expressly revised below. This markup should be conformed to the final execution copy and checked against the complete APA if any excerpt discrepancy arises.

# HEADLINE MUST-CHANGES

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Issue**               **Draft position**                                                  **Seller revision / quantified effect**
  ----------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Liability cap           200% of total Service Charges paid as of claim                      APA §7.12(d): fees actually paid in trailing 12 months. At estimated fees, \$13.464M vs. draft-as-written \$41.004M at month 18; delta \$27.540M.

  IT fee                  15% markup; \$391,000/month                                         10% markup; \$374,000/month. Draft overcharge \$17,000/month and \$306,000 over 18 months, before actual-cost adjustments.

  Service standard        24-month lookback; equal or better; industry best practices         12-month lookback; substantially consistent; no external/best-practice overlay.

  Term / termination      Automatic renewals and 120-day service termination notice           18-month hard stop; no automatic renewal; 90-day notice.

  Damages                 One-way waiver protecting Trident only                              Mutual waiver, subject to APA third-party indemnity carve-out.

  IP                      Perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to Polaris materials   No license; access solely as needed to receive Services during the applicable term.

  Mexico                  U.S.-only privacy; no allocation of IMMEX responsibilities          LFPDPPP processing terms and IMMEX responsibility, cost, records, notices, and transition mechanics.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ARTICLE-BY-ARTICLE MARKUP

## Preamble / definitions

--- output/tsa-review-memo.docx
**Attorney-Client Work Product --- Seller-Side TSA Review**

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **To**                              Victoria S. Andersen, Partner
  ----------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **From**                            Transaction Review Team

  **Date**                            May 2, 2025

  **Matter**                          Polaris / Trident --- TSA Markup Assignment --- Specialty Coatings Divestiture

  **Deliverables**                    Seller-side redline and this priority-tiered review memo
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The Trident draft is materially buyer-favorable and should not be signed without the Critical corrections below. The most serious issues are (i) an APA-inconsistent liability cap and one-way consequential-damages waiver; (ii) a 15% IT markup and fixed-fee structure inconsistent with APA §7.12(b); (iii) a 24-month/best-practice service standard; (iv) automatic renewals and 120-day termination notice contrary to APA §7.12(a) and (c); and (v) missing Monterrey IMMEX and LFPDPPP allocation language required by APA §7.12(g). Separately, the draft gives Trident a perpetual IP license and consent rights over Polaris personnel, both unacceptable under the Polaris playbook.

The redline corrects these points and adds playbook protections on payment, escalation, change orders, termination assistance, non-solicitation, audit limits, force-majeure exit rights, insurance, governing law, and arbitration. Polaris should lead with the firm positions identified as "must-change" and retain flexibility on administrative details and certain fallback economics.

# ALERT FOR SHARON PETROSIAN

Two issues merit immediate escalation before the May 1 call: (1) the draft's IP license is perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, sublicensable, and reaches Polaris tools, methodologies, software, and know-how used across the enterprise; and (2) the draft's liability formula could produce approximately \$41.004 million of exposure at month 18 versus an estimated APA cap of \$13.464 million. The Monterrey omissions also create material customs, tax, employment-data, and operational continuity risk if not allocated before Closing.

# QUANTIFIED FEE / LIABILITY ANALYSIS

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Metric**                     **Draft as written**                              **APA / Exhibit H**                                                       **Delta / comment**
  ------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IT monthly fee                 \$391,000 (15%)                                   \$374,000 (10%)                                                           \$17,000/month over APA estimate; \$306,000 over 18 months.

  Total estimated monthly fees   \$1,139,000                                       \$1,122,000                                                               \$17,000/month; draft total is not an APA-compliant fee schedule.

  Estimated 18-month fees        \$20,502,000                                      \$20,196,000                                                              \$306,000 excess, before actual-cost adjustments.

  Liability cap at month 18      200% × \$20,502,000 = \$41,004,000                Trailing 12 months: \$1,122,000 × 12 = \$13,464,000                       Draft exposure exceeds APA-based estimate by \$27,540,000 (approximately 3.05×).

  Cap methodology                Total fees paid as of claim, multiplied by 200%   Fees actually paid in prior 12 months; first 12 months Closing-to-claim   Direct conflict with APA §7.12(d).
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
